scope: Ordinary outside-pad TMC2209 ground thermal spreading candidate; no via-in-pad exception or fabrication qualification implied.
construction: Ordinary plated through vias outside all component pads; both sides tented; no fill/cap requirement.
qualification_required: Full native/independent drill/copper checks, actual top copper continuity from EP to both vias and solid inner ground, measured neck and CAM mask/drill verification.
